evidence.experimental_conditions: CBA/Ca female mice; vehicles: AOO (4:1), DMSO, acetone:saline (1:1), DMF, MEK, acetone; concentrations 2.5–50% w/v; application to ears; 5 mice per group.
evidence.support_text: Benzocaine was tested in the murine local lymph node assay (LLNA) at 2.5-50% w/v in six vehicles (AOO, DMSO, acetone:saline, DMF, MEK, acetone) using CBA/Ca mice. Stimulation indices (SI) were measured relative to controls. The required SI for a positive sensitization call is >=3. In no vehicle or concentration was SI >=3 achieved; the highest SI was 2.99 for 5% benzocaine in acetone, but no dose-response relationship was observed. The authors concluded that benzocaine failed to elicit positive responses in a standard LLNA in all vehicles tested.

evidence.support_text: Apalutamide elicits a positive response in the mouse drug allergy model.
